name: linear_inequality_obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit conditional implication logic ("if not A then B") with a mathematically equivalent linear inequality constraint ($L_1 + L_2 \le 1$) over binary variables. This mimics a load-balancing or ILP problem, forcing the model to algebraically deduce the 2-SAT structure rather than pattern-matching the implication edges from the text.
